title: GTA V Made One Billion Dollars in Just Three Days

scenes.text: One video game made a billion dollars in three days.
It was Grand Theft Auto Five, released on September 17, 2013.
On day one alone, it sold 11.2 million copies.
That is about eight hundred million dollars in twenty-four hours.
By day three it passed one billion, faster than any entertainment product ever.
A billion dollars. Three days. A video game.

description:
Grand Theft Auto V sold 11.2 million copies on its first day and passed one billion dollars in just three days, which Guinness World Records lists as the fastest entertainment property ever.
Were you in line for it? Comment below.
first_comment: A billion in three days. What is the best game you ever bought on day one?
